parameters.name: GroupUuid
parameters.description:
The unique ID of the address book.

> You can call the [DescribeAddressBook](~~DescribeAddressBook~~) operation to query the ID.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type. Valid values:

- **en**: English
- **zh**: Chinese (default).

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.
